verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a chat, agent, and git collaboration platform like Buzz, so the axis applies. The documented CLI commands (channels create, repos protect set, workflows trigger) each act on a single item, and none is described as working on many items at once. YAML workflows and a scriptable CLI are only developer building blocks a user could script around, not a documented bulk-operation capability, so they earn no credit.
